view: Frontal chest radiograph, likely AP erect (scapulae partially projected over the upper lateral lung fields); no L/R letter marker seen, a chevron-shaped marker at the upper right image corner; conventional orientation assumed (gastric bubble and cardiac apex on image right = patient's left)
technical_quality: Adequate. No significant rotation (medial clavicular ends roughly equidistant from the spinous processes). Adequate inspiration (about 8-9 posterior ribs). Exposure adequate with vertebral bodies visible through the cardiac shadow. Both lung apices and costophrenic angles included. Bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones; scapulae overlap the upper lateral lung fields.

devices.location: Left hemithorax: enters through the left lateral lower chest wall (about 6th-7th rib level), courses superiorly along the lateral pleural surface with tip at the left apex / upper zone; external tubing continues downward along the left flank and lower abdomen to the image edge

devices.type: Second tubular linear structure (possible second pleural drain / catheter, or drainage tubing; pneumomediastinal mediastinal pleural line is a differential)
devices.location: Left paramediastinal region, running vertically along the left cardiac border from the upper mediastinum down to the left hemidiaphragm (left middle-lower zone)

devices.type: Small metallic clip / coil-like density (surgical clip or catheter tip, uncertain)
devices.location: Left upper paravertebral region at about the T2-T3 level, adjacent to the spine (patient's left)
Upper right corner of the image (patient's left), outside the chest

abnormalities.finding: Subcutaneous emphysema: streaky linear lucencies in the soft tissues of the lateral chest wall and axillary region
abnormalities.zone: multiple (lateral chest wall from axilla to lower chest)

abnormalities.finding: Possible small residual apical pneumothorax adjacent to the chest tube tip (thin pleural line suspected, not definite)
Possible pneumomediastinum: linear lucency with a thin pleural line along the left cardiac border (alternatively this represents a second drain/tubing, see devices)
Mildly reduced left lung volume with the left hemidiaphragm at or slightly above the level of the right hemidiaphragm

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為AP直立位），吸氣度與曝光尚可，無明顯旋轉，雙側肩胛骨部分重疊於上肺野，雙側乳影重疊於下肺野。左側可見胸管自左下外側胸壁進入胸腔並沿外側胸膜面向上延伸，末端位於左肺尖／上肺野；另於左心緣旁可見一垂直走行之管狀線影延伸至左橫膈（可能為第二條引流管或引流管線，亦需考慮縱隔氣腫之縱隔胸膜線），左上縱隔旁（約T2-T3）另見小型金屬夾／線圈狀高密度影。左側外側胸壁及腋下軟組織可見條紋狀透亮影，符合皮下氣腫；左肺尖不排除少量殘餘氣胸，左肺容積略減。右肺清晰、雙側肋膈角銳利、氣管居中、心臟大小及縱隔位置正常，骨骼結構無明顯骨折或破壞。
